1.

Not distant is the moment, When the Lord shall come In glory in the clouds With all His saints.

2.

The dark night flees, Soon morning shall appear, When every pilgrim’s eye shall see Its Lord’s countenance.

3.

In His Father’s house Our dwelling He has prepared, Where light and love shall reign In eternal glory.

4.

And without hindrance there In blessed rest with God The redeemed hosts shall raise clearly An eternal song of praise.

5.

Come then, O Lord, soon, Bid the dead arise. That we also, transformed, May go to meet Thee!
